negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed was observed on the Banka Slovenije announcements hub (https://www.bsi.si/sl/mediji/objave). The page offers only category filters and an email newsletter subscription.
negative_findings.result_summary: Direct fetch of the listing rendered categories and items but exposed no feed URL.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must rely on HTML crawling and diffing rather than a feed, raising fragility and cost; an email-newsletter subscription may be a cheaper change trigger.

negative_findings.description: https://www.a-tvp.si/nadzorovani-subjekti-/javne-druzbe returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a plain fetch, while the page is clearly indexed and linked.
negative_findings.result_summary: 403 on one attempt; treated as bot-defended-but-live hypothesis, NOT as dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The whole a-tvp.si domain (issuer lists, enforcement, prospectuses) may need a headless browser or realistic UA/headers; a naive collector would wrongly mark these critical registers as dead.

negative_findings.description: The OAM (Officially Appointed Mechanism) repository of issuers' regulated information was referenced by ATVP-derived search results as www.oam.si, but I did not fetch it in this pass and did not confirm its search interface or whether it is served under a different host/path.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: OAM is potentially the single highest-value endpoint for annual/half-year reports of Slovenian issuers; its exact address and query interface must be confirmed before it is relied on.

negative_findings.description: I did not locate a dedicated, dated press-release index for AZN comparable to BS's /mediji/objave; the closest observed is 'Stališča in obvestila Agencije' plus the annual reports archive.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched in Slovenian; only notices and annual-report pages surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Insurance-supervisor news flow may need to be captured via the notices page and the WordPress uploads directory rather than a proper newsroom.

negative_findings.description: English-language searching surfaced only mirrored bsi.si/en pages; no English-language equivalents were found for ATVP or AZN registers and enforcement pages in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: en queries returned bsi.si/en publication, statistics and supervisory-disclosure pages plus Wikipedia; nothing new for ATVP/AZN.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that Slovenian-language collection is mandatory for the securities and insurance supervisors; an English-only pipeline would miss most of this cell.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian AML supervisor Urad RS za preprečevanje pranja denarja (Office for Money Laundering Prevention) and the Ministry of Finance were not searched in this pass, although both publish binding guidance affecting banks and PSPs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run sl-language queries for 'Urad RS za preprečevanje pranja denarja letno poročilo' and 'Ministrstvo za finance finančni sistem plačilne storitve' and classify their publication hubs.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovenian significant banks are supervised by the ECB/SSM and appear in EBA/ESMA/EIOPA EU-level registers (credit institutions register, payment institutions register under PSD2, ESMA prospectus register). These EU pointers were not enumerated here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated pass over ECB SSM supervised-entities list, EBA credit-institutions and PSD2 registers, and ESMA registers, filtered to SI.

coverage_gaps.description: Banka Slovenije's statistical data warehouse / time-series download interface (beyond the HTML statistics landing pages) was not identified; whether an SDMX or bulk-download endpoint exists for payment statistics is unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe bsi.si statistics section and the ECB SDW/Data Portal for SI payment-statistics series to enable numeric time-series collection instead of PDF scraping.

coverage_gaps.description: a-tvp.si appears bot-defended (403), so its registers, enforcement decisions and prospectus pages are currently uncollectable with a plain HTTP client.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test a headless-browser fetch path with realistic headers and rate limits against a-tvp.si before treating any of its pages as dead; record robots.txt terms.

coverage_gaps.description: Archive depth of BS press releases and ATVP enforcement listings was not established (how far back pagination goes, whether older items are retired).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe deep pagination and consider Wayback Machine backfill for pre-existing history on bsi.si/mediji/objave and a-tvp.si enforcement lists.

brief: Slovenia's supervisory disclosure layer is concentrated in three publishers: Banka Slovenije (banks, payment institutions, e-money institutions, payment-system oversight and payment statistics), ATVP (issuers, investment firms, prospectuses, and the OAM regulated-information repository), and AZN (insurers, pension companies, and the distribution register). Banka Slovenije is by far the richest and most collectable: an open, well-structured site with a filterable announcements hub, a publications catalogue with an advance release calendar, statutory supervisory disclosures, a named-entity enforcement list, and registers that together form the canonical actor map for both banking and payments; its English mirror covers publications and statistics but not everything. ATVP holds the highest-value annual-report and issuer-disclosure material (OAM, ESEF filings, enforcement measures) but its domain returned 403 to a plain fetch, so it should be treated as bot-defended-but-live and approached with a headless browser rather than written off. Slovenian-language terminology is mandatory throughout - nadzorniška razkritja, izrečeni ukrepi, register subjektov nadzora, nadzorovani subjekti, letno poročilo - since ATVP and AZN publish essentially only in Slovenian; the main remaining gaps are the EU-level layer (ECB/SSM, EBA, ESMA registers filtered to SI), the AML office and Ministry of Finance, and any structured/SDMX data endpoint behind the payment statistics.
